etl_logic: LEFT JOIN (SELECT BRANCH_ID, BRANCH_NAME_VN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BRANCH_ID ORDER BY TRANSACTION_OFF_ID) AS rn FROM NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_BRANCH) B ON B.BRANCH_ID = NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_COMPANY.BRANCH_ID AND B.rn = 1 → B.BRANCH_ID
note: Review 2026-10-12: MAS_BRANCH grain thật là TRANSACTION_OFF_ID (chi tiết hơn BRANCH_ID, chưa dùng ở model này) — dedup về 1 dòng/BRANCH_ID bằng ROW_NUMBER() PARTITION BY BRANCH_ID ORDER BY TRANSACTION_OFF_ID, lấy rn=1, tránh fan-out khi join vào MAS_COMPANY. Layer Branch

etl_logic: LEFT JOIN (SELECT BRANCH_ID, BRANCH_NAME_VN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BRANCH_ID ORDER BY TRANSACTION_OFF_ID) AS rn FROM NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_BRANCH) B ON B.BRANCH_ID = NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_COMPANY.BRANCH_ID AND B.rn = 1 → B.BRANCH_NAME_VN

description: Mã khu vực địa lý — layer Region
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN (SELECT BRANCH_ID, REGION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BRANCH_ID ORDER BY TRANSACTION_OFF_ID) AS rn FROM NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_BRANCH) B ON B.BRANCH_ID = NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_COMPANY.BRANCH_ID AND B.rn = 1 → LEFT JOIN NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_REGION ON NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_REGION.REGION_CODE = B.REGION → NG_SB_RLOS_MAS_REGION.REGION_CODE
note: Review 2026-10-12: Multi-hop qua subquery dedup B (1 dòng/BRANCH_ID) → MAS_REGION (REGION_CODE=B.REGION) — xem note cột BRANCH_CODE. Layer Region
